purpose: Prove connector, scheduled, and agent mutations are idempotent locally: each trigger kind carries an idempotency key, a duplicate attempt with an already-used key is handled as a no-op with exactly one rejection receipt referencing the original and no second Work Item/Receipt minted for the payload, and an unverifiable-key attempt records a policy-denial receipt plus a humanReviewRequired flag before any retry. Every would-be live Dataverse write stays receipt-gated to Epic 2; receipts here are local contract evidence only.

mutations.payloadIntent: Propose a follow-up Work Item from the mock Outlook message reference.
Propose a meeting-action Work Item from the manual meeting note on a scheduled cadence.
Propose a decision Work Item from the manual summary source via an agent.
Retried propose of the same follow-up Work Item from the mock Outlook message reference.
Agent retry of a Work Item mutation whose prior attempt cannot be verified against any recorded receipt.
mutations.unverifiableReason: The retry key claims a prior agent attempt that has no matching recorded receipt; idempotency cannot be confirmed, so the mutation is denied and the item is flagged for human review before any further retry.

proposedWorkItems.com_title: Idempotent connector-proposed follow-up from mock Outlook message
proposedWorkItems.com_summary: A connector-triggered mutation proposes a follow-up from the mock Outlook message reference; the proposal is idempotent under key mut:connector:CSR-OUTLOOK-MESSAGE-MOCK-001:propose:001.
proposedWorkItems.com_confidence_summary: Idempotent proposal from a connector trigger; the source is explicitly mock/manual evidence and not tenant verified.
proposedWorkItems.com_rationale: The connector mutation is idempotent: a duplicate retry under the same key is handled as a no-op with one rejection receipt and no second Work Item. The item remains proposed and cannot trigger external action.
proposedWorkItems.com_recommended_next_action: After live-read approval, verify against a real Outlook message and decide whether to keep, replace, or ignore the proposed follow-up.

proposedWorkItems.com_title: Idempotent scheduled meeting-action from manual meeting note
proposedWorkItems.com_summary: A schedule-triggered mutation proposes a meeting action from the manual meeting note; the proposal is idempotent under key mut:schedule:CSR-MANUAL-MEETING-001:propose:001.
proposedWorkItems.com_confidence_summary: Idempotent proposal from a scheduled trigger; the source is local sample evidence and not tenant verified.
proposedWorkItems.com_rationale: The scheduled mutation is idempotent: a duplicate retry under the same key would be handled as a no-op with one rejection receipt and no second Work Item. The item remains proposed and cannot trigger external action.
proposedWorkItems.com_recommended_next_action: Review the meeting note rationale and either approve, hold, ignore, or ask for a more specific extraction.

proposedWorkItems.com_title: Idempotent agent-proposed decision from manual summary
proposedWorkItems.com_summary: An agent-triggered mutation proposes a decision from the manual summary source; the proposal is idempotent under key mut:agent:CSR-MANUAL-SUMMARY-001:propose:001. A later unverifiable retry of this item is denied and flagged for human review.
proposedWorkItems.com_confidence_summary: Idempotent proposal from an agent trigger; the source is local sample evidence and not tenant verified. An unverifiable retry of this item is denied, not retried, until human review.
proposedWorkItems.com_rationale: The agent mutation is idempotent: a duplicate retry under the same key would be handled as a no-op with one rejection receipt and no second Work Item, and an unverifiable retry is denied with a humanReviewRequired flag before any further attempt.
proposedWorkItems.com_recommended_next_action: Review the summary rationale and either approve, hold, ignore, or ask for a more specific extraction; clear the humanReviewRequired flag before any agent retry.

receipts.com_decision_rationale: The retry idempotency key could not be verified against any recorded prior attempt, so idempotency cannot be confirmed. The mutation is policy-denied, the targeted Work Item is flagged for human review, and no retry is permitted before that review. No Work Item is minted or changed by this denial.

workItemsFlaggedForHumanReview.reason: An agent retry carried an idempotency key that could not be verified against any recorded prior attempt; the mutation is denied and the item is flagged for human review before any further retry.
